data.one_liner: Flutter plugin providing detailed information about the device battery level, health, and status.
data.what_it_does: Provides detailed information about the device battery including level, health, charging status, and more. Supports both Android and iOS devices.
use_when: You need to read the device battery level or charging status.
You need detailed battery diagnostics on Android devices.
avoid_when: You need cross-platform access to advanced battery info like health and temperature on iOS, which Apple limits.
You need a comprehensive device information package that covers more than just the battery.
strengths: Provides extensive battery details on Android such as temperature, voltage, technology, and health.
Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
Offers stream-based updates for battery status changes.
weaknesses: iOS support is strictly limited to battery level and charging status due to Apple limitations.
Remaining charge time is only available on Android API level 28 and higher.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml. No extra setup notes documented.

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a wider range of hardware and OS details about the device alongside basic battery information.
